hook.name: OfficialFloorHook
hook.description: A custom bonding-curve swap hook for the FLOOP token. It completely replaces pool swap mechanics: ETH-in buys mint FLOOP (routing funds through an ETH treasury vault), and FLOOP-in sells burn the tokens and return ETH. Liquidity additions are forbidden; the hook enforces a coverage invariant to maintain an ETH-backed floor price.
